q16_and_q18_verdict.q16: Partial answer only. Real category (remote/hosted MCP over Streamable HTTP) with a curated directory (github.com/jaw9c/awesome-remote-mcp-servers) and a URL test harness (mcpplaygroundonline.com), but no single dominant named server the way most other questions produced one.
q16_and_q18_verdict.q18: Partial/fragmented answer. Four different marketplaces surfaced (AgenticMarket per-call, MCPize creator-priced, Apify pay-per-event, MCPBundles subscription) with no consensus 'go here' marketplace and materially different pricing models.
q16_and_q18_verdict.overall: These are the two weakest of the 18 answers — information exists but neither resolves to one confident named recommendation.
